resources.string: Show the proposals of external models
No proposal is waiting. What a model proposes for this document shows here, and nothing changes until you accept it.
Add a text on a new page
This text changed after the model read it: it will not be overwritten.
Not applied: the text had changed
Let clients in on this device
Programs on this computer, like a coding assistant or a script, can read the documents you allow and propose changes. What they read goes to the model they use, under its terms.
A document can hold text written by others, even instructions meant to mislead a model: review what is proposed.
From a terminal, run “pencilnotes docs”. A client of the Model Context Protocol starts “pencilnotes mcp”.
